🔥 The fire settles. Nikos has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nevermore — I put it down today." "Its shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides across the ground toward you — a straight black lane, growing. The bird hasn't moved. The shadow has." "It climbs, laughing in a dead voice — out of spear reach, watching." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Stan says "Say that again — slower." Debbie says quietly "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
